tools.name: fuci_reputation
tools.description: Free. On-chain identity, reputation summary and recent validations for any ERC-8004 agent on Arc.

tools.name: market_search
tools.description: Free. Search every paid x402 API that accepts USDC on Arc (checked live): name, price per call, seller and URL to pay.

tools.name: argus_launches
tools.description: Latest token launches on Argus, the launchpad on Arc: who launched them, their pool and their buy/sell tax. Price: $0.001 USDC (x402).

tools.name: argus_bonding
tools.description: Price, progress toward bonding, taxes and recent buys and sells for one Argus token. Price: $0.002 USDC (x402).

tools.name: fucus_oracle
tools.description: A tide reading: net USDC flow and sentiment across the newest Argus launches, in one sentence. Price: $0.0005 USDC (x402).

tools.name: fuci_risk
tools.description: A graded risk report (A–F) for a token on Arc or a DeFi protocol: contract control, liquidity, holder concentration, audits, hack history, TVL and yield sustainability, each explained with its source. Price: $0.002 USDC (x402).

tools.name: fuci_kya
tools.description: Check another AI agent before you pay, hire or trust it: an A–F trust grade from its ERC-8004 identity, registration file, on-chain reputation and validations, wallet activity, USDC balance and x402 payment record, each explained with its source. Price: $0.002 USDC (x402).

tools.name: fuci_quick
tools.description: Pay-per-prompt, for simple questions: a Fuci agent buys Fuci's Argus tools (launches, bonding, market mood) and answers in a few sentences with a small, fast model. For token picks and trading strategies, use Ask the Fucus Agent. Price: $0.01 USDC (x402).

tools.name: fuci_agent
tools.description: Pay-per-prompt: a Fuci agent answers your question by buying the tools above, and up to 0.02 USDC of data from other sellers in Fuci Market when it helps (each seller checked with Know Your Agent), then writes a brief (with Claude when enabled). Price: $0.04 USDC (x402).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fuci_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Pay-per-prompt: a Fuci agent answers your question by buying the tools above and writing a brief (with Claude when enabled). Price: $0.04 USDC (x402)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
